title: Quick-Malaysian-Zingy Citrus Peel Thai-Bird-Chili Skewers
description: A quick-fix Malaysian dish featuring Thai bird chilies and citrus peel for a zesty and flaky taste. Suitable as an appetizer or snack, vegan-friendly.

ingredients.name: 1 cup mixed leafy greens (e.g. bok choy, kale)

instructions: Wash and prepare the citrus peels by removing any white pith.
Slice the Thai bird chilies into thin rings.
Mix lime juice, lemon juice, salt, and lemongrass juice in a bowl. Stir until the salt dissolves.
Place mixed leafy greens on bamboo skewers.
Gently place slices of citrus peels on each green vegetable.
Add Thai bird chili rings between the citrus and vegetables for added flavor.
Drizzle with the prepared seasoning mixture from above.
Let stand at room temperature before grilling or pan-frying. Enjoy hot.
